description:
Fender Tune is the top-rated, precision tuner app for guitar, bass and ukulele from the most trusted name in guitars, Fender®. Accurately tune your instrument with Fender Tune’s easy-to-use interface, perfect for all musicians from beginners to pros.

Sign up for a free Fender account to unlock the largest suite of guitar playing resources. Whether you are just getting started or an expert at your instrument - get more out of your practice and take your playing to the next level with the all-in-one tuner app. Plus, stay looped in on the latest Fender products and exclusive gear discounts.

Download today and tune like a pro with Fender.

PRECISE & CUSTOMIZABLE TUNING MODES

How it works:

Auto-Tune Mode - Pluck a string and the tuner listens to the note to guide you to a perfect pitch. A string-by-string diagram guides the selected tuning.

Manual Tune Mode - Tap a string on the interactive Fender headstock to hear the note and tune your acoustic guitar, electric guitar, bass or ukulele.

Chromatic Mode - The tuner recognizes each of the 12 chromatic (semitone) steps of the equal-tempered scale, allowing you to tune to any note on the scale.

Alternate Tunings - 26 tunings available, including: Standard (EADGBE), Open G, Drop D, Open D and Drop C.

Custom Tunings - Create your own custom tunings and save to your Fender Connect personal profile for easy access.

INTRODUCING TUNE PLUS: THE ULTIMATE ALL-IN-ONE PRACTICE TOOLKIT
Looking for more than a standard guitar tuner? For a limited time, sign-up to gain full access to Tune Plus - the largest suite of FREE guitar-playing resources in a mobile app. No credit card required. Get more out of your practice with interactive guitar chords and scales, built-in customizable drum beats, advanced precision tuning capabilities, a metronome and more. All you need is the Fender Tune app and your instrument.

PRO TUNER
Tune your guitar, bass or ukulele with greater visual precision and flexibility
• Get real-time visual feedback to find the exact tuning you're seeking
• Explore more tuning styles with exact cents and hertz reference
• Choose from 40 different non-standard tuning references from A=420Hz to A=460Hz

EASY-TO-USE GUITAR LIBRARY
Discover new sonic possibilities with Fender’s dynamic guitar chord library which creates any chord pattern, with multiple shape variations, anywhere on the neck.
• Interact with over 5000 guitar chords by dragging your finger across the diagram to hear the chord before you play.
• Get chord diagrams and finger placement for every chord variation in any position
• Browse through curated collections of chords or find chords by their root note
• Includes chords for six-string guitar only

INTERACTIVE GUITAR SCALES
Fender’s dynamic scale library improves your lead playing by quickly teaching complex scales with easy-to-understand visuals.
• Hear how over 2000 guitar scales sound before you play them by pressing down on each note of the interactive scale diagrams.
• Find scale diagrams and patterns for any variation, flavor and key - anywhere on the fretboard.
• Includes scales for six-string guitar only

METRONOME & DRUM TRACKS 
Stay in time with metronome mode and improve your playing with a flexible drum kit based on an authentic acoustic drum kit designed for Fender.
• Easy to use metronome with customizable time signatures and sounds
• Choose from 65 unique one-touch, pre-programmed drum rhythms across 7 genres (Rock, Blues, Jazz, Metal, Funk/R&B, Country/Folk and World) including: 90s Rock, Chicago Bounce, Kingston Groove and many more.
• Select your tempo and customize your time signature to practice with any rhythm

TUNING TIPS
• Helpful tutorial videos to teach you the basics of tuning your instrument
• Tuning tips to help you get the best performance out of your tuning app

--

Since 1946, Fender® has set the standard for expertly crafted, high-performance instruments and audio equipment.

description:
The "Three Essentials" of music practice, unified on one screen.
Metronome, Tuner, and Recorder. We have integrated the three indispensable tools for every musician into one elegant and intuitive interface. No more switching between apps—stay fully focused on your music.

- Professional Precision: 1/44,100 sec.
Do you have doubts about the accuracy of digital metronomes? Smart Metronome controls timing and sound playback via hardware, not just software. This guarantees an exact pulse, independent of CPU load, with a precision of 1/44,100th of a second. Technically, it is the same as listening to a recorded CD.

- Ultra-Realistic Visual Pendulum
We have recreated the physical movement of a mechanical metronome. The sound triggers exactly as the pendulum passes through the center, allowing you to "see" the tempo as well as hear it for intuitive synchronization.

- Exclusive Features to Maximize Your Efficiency

*** 3-in-1 Interface: Everything at Once**
Tune your instrument while you play. Record your session instantly and analyze rhythmic errors visually thanks to the "Metronome Guide" overlaid on the audio waveform.

*** Repeat Mode: Master Difficult Passages**
Ideal for tackling tricky sections. Start at a slow tempo and increase the speed automatically. Set the start and goal tempos and the number of repetitions to build your scales and arpeggios with total focus.

*** Program Mode: For Complex Pieces**
Freely program changes in time signature, tempo, and bar counts. Perfect for contemporary music or pieces with shifting rhythms (rit. / accel.). Includes rehearsal marks on screen so you always know where you are in the score.

*** Continuous Timer & LOG: Practice Management**
Manage your routines with the continuous timer. Every minute of your practice is saved in the LOG, allowing you to visualize your progress and consistency over time.

- Key Features at a Glance

Unified Interface: Metronome, Tuner, and Recording on a single screen.

Customization: Set your favorite colors and choose from a wide range of sounds.

Drum Machine: High-quality percussion and drum sounds.

Setlist: Save and organize tempos for your entire repertoire.

Versatility: Excellent for music, but also for gym routines or interval training.

Make your daily practice more enjoyable, rigorous, and effective with Smart Metronome!

For musicians from pros to beginners, whether you sing, play a brass, woodwind or stringed instrument or any type of guitar, this app provides a set of feature-rich practice tools that gives fun and rewarding feedback. It’s much more than just a tuner!
      
So what makes the TonalEnergy the best selling music practice app?
 
• It's an all-in-one app, with a state-of-the-art tuner, an advanced metronome, dedicated orchestral strings and guitar tuning page, a piano keyboard, sound analysis pages, and audio/visual recording capabilities.

• It’s easy to use. Options like the Target Tuner or Pitch Tracker are on all the main pages.  TonalEnergy helps users create rewarding and attainable goals during a rehearsal or when working alone. Colorful analysis data pages and audio/video recording features enhance the experience of practice.  

• The metronome is cutting edge. It offers unmatched flexibility in sound choices, tempo settings, meters, subdivision patterns and visual displays. Voice count-ins, the ability to create and edit preset groups and Ableton link for syncing multiple devices make this a superior tool for performers. 

• Ear training possibilities are endless. The high quality multi-sampled instrument sounds for symphonic instruments are unique among all other tuning applications. Listening skills can be developed through the use of the eight-octave keyboard, chromatic wheel and tone generator. There are no other sounds like these. 

• Learning is a social activity. Using features unique to the TonalEnergy Tuner, data can be collected, reviewed, edited and shared with others. Feedback is essential for growing and developing great performers. It’s all about connectivity.

Chris Coletti, member of The Canadian Brass, sums up TonalEnergy by saying,

      “TonalEnergy is a must-have for any serious musician. It's a full suite of tools in one app; the tuner, tone generator, recorder, metronome and beautiful interface make it one of the best tools for musicians out there, period.” 

FEATURES

• Recognizes a large pitch range, extending to lower registers than many competing tuners (C0 - C8) that is highly responsive to wind instruments, as well as acoustic and electric string instruments
• Adjustable A=440 Hz reference 
• Automatic or manual transposing options
• Instantly changes between equal, just and other custom temperaments, including user-defined ones
• Auto or instant pitch reference note feature using the TonalEnergy sounds
• Extensive tuning list for all orchestral string and fretted string instruments including many more features than most other string-only tuner apps
• An expandable eight octave piano keyboard enhancing many of the key aspects of the tuner’s functions
• Chromatic wheel tone generator, with optional auto-vibrato feature
• Frequency and Harmonic energy overtone graphs, along with a multi-function waveform
• Dedicated metronome page that matches or exceeds the features available on all other stand alone metronome apps
• Notation options including standard English, Solfege, Northern European, and Indian variants
• Bluetooth output/input support
• Audio and Video recording capabilities including, editing, looping, timestretch that are all exportable via iTunes sharing, AirDrop, email, AudioCopy, SoundCloud, etc
• Import music from iTunes Library or email attachments
• Compatible with external microphones and clip-on vibration sensor devices
• Supports external video output to an external display for use in rehearsal halls
• External MIDI keyboard control support 
• Apple Watch app acts ONLY as a remote control for the phone app
• Audiobus and inter-app audio support
• VoiceOver support for the blind or visually impaired 

INSTRUMENT SOUNDS
• Piccolo, Flute
• Oboe, English Horn, Bassoon
• Full Clarinet Family
• Soprano, Alto, Tenor, and Baritone Saxophone
• Trumpet
• French Horn
• Tenor and Bass Trombone
• Euphonium and Tuba
• Square, sawtooth, and sine waveforms
• Organ
• Bowed and Plucked Strings
releaseNotes:
New Features:

  • Added Drone After Delay option to Auto-Tone Tracker. Enable it from new options by long-pressing the auto-tone-tracker button (mic with 8th notes button).
    This allows you to hear your own sound before hearing the automatic drone(s) which is a valuable practice technique. Some of the options also allow for continuing the drone during legato play, and only causing it to change notes when you sustain a pitch long enough.
    
  • Added many new remote control commands, including ones that can make use of sliders/knobs
  • Have internal sound recording button in sidebar on all pages
  • Added MIDI pitch bend allowed option and bend range control
    
Fixes:
  • Fixed issue with Sustain toggle remote control command from the last update
  • Fixed count-in issue when polyrhythm is enabled, now only use primary rhythm for count-in
  • Fixed slide out mixer system volume adjustability issue
  • Fixed remote control temperament toggle screen update
  • Fixed layout issues with slide-down met tempo wheel

description:
CoachTuner is a FREE chromatic instrument tuner that allows you to quickly tune your guitar, bass and ukulele using the built-in mic of your iPhone/iPad/iPod. CoachTuner can tune acoustic or electric guitar, bass, ukulele. It's easy to use for beginners and it's Free.

*** How to use CoachTuner ? ***
The open strings of a guitar from the thickest to thinest are as follows:

E – the thickest or lowest sounding string is known as the 6th string
A – is the 5th
D – is the 4th
G – is the 3rd
B – is the 2nd
E – the thinest or highest is the 1st

1) First, play your low E string (6th string), the arrow must be in the middle and the text "E" and "OK" must be displayed
2) Play your low A string (5th string), the arrow must be in the middle and the text "A" and "OK" must be displayed
3) Play your low D string (4th string), the arrow must be in the middle and the text "D" and "OK" must be displayed
4) Play your low G string (3th string), the arrow must be in the middle and the text "G" and "OK" must be displayed
5) Play your low B string (2th string), the arrow must be in the middle and the text "B" and "OK" must be displayed
6) Play your high E string (1th string), the arrow must be in the middle and the text "E" and "OK" must be displayed

The mechanics of tuning a guitar are simple. To adjust the pitch of a string, turn the string’s corresponding tuning key on the head of the guitar.

description:
Tuner T1 is the ultimate instrument tuner, designed for precision tuning of a wide range of musical instruments. Whether you're tuning a guitar, violin, viola, bass, piano, cello, flute, or any other instrument, Tuner T1 ensures impeccable accuracy and ease of use. Ideal for both professional musicians and beginners, this chromatic tuner app is built to handle all common instruments with incredible precision, making it an essential tool for any musician.

Key Features:

• Extremely Accurate Tuning: Tune your instrument with an exceptional level of accuracy (within ±0.1 cents), ensuring perfect pitch every time.
• Chromatic Tuner for All Instruments: Tuner T1 supports a broad range of instruments, including guitar, bass, violin, viola, cello, piano, flute, and more. Whether you're tuning strings, winds, or brass, Tuner T1 has you covered.
• Transpose Mode: Instantly transpose the tuner’s note display without affecting pitch detection - perfect for real-world playing scenarios. Supports transposing notes up or down in ½-step increments (−12 to +12). Shows written pitch for transposing instruments such as Bb Trumpet, Eb Alto Sax, F Horn, and more.
• Tone Generator: Generate reference tones over a 3-octave range. Perfect for ear training or manual tuning when needed, the tone generator covers every note you need.
• Adjustable A₄ Frequency: For those who need custom tunings, Tuner T1 allows you to change the A₄ reference frequency from the standard 440 Hz to other frequencies to suit any musical or regional style.
• Beautiful, Simple, & Easy-to-Use Interface: Tuner T1 is designed to be intuitive, allowing you to start tuning instantly without any complicated setup. It’s built with simplicity in mind while maintaining all the advanced features you need for professional-grade tuning.
• Perfect for Professional and Amateur Musicians: Whether you're a professional musician performing on stage or an aspiring player honing your skills, Tuner T1 provides the accuracy and reliability you need to ensure your instrument is perfectly in tune every time.
• Optimized for Low-Latency Performance: Our app delivers low-latency pitch detection, ensuring quick response times without sacrificing accuracy, making it a great tool for live performances or recording sessions.
• Battery-Efficient: Tuner T1 is designed to minimize battery consumption, letting you use the app for extended tuning sessions without draining your device’s power.

Why Choose Tuner T1?

Tuner T1 stands out from other tuning apps because of its superior accuracy, intelligent transpose capabilities, and low-latency pitch detection, specifically optimized for tuning a wide variety of common instruments. This app is built to cater to the needs of guitarists, violinists, pianists, and wind players using transposing instruments across different genres. With its sleek interface, customizable settings, and tone generation capabilities, Tuner T1 is not only powerful but incredibly user-friendly.

Unlock Your Musical Potential

With Tuner T1, you’re not just getting an ordinary tuner. You’re getting a tool that helps you achieve perfect pitch, fine-tune your ear, and enhance your performance. Whether you're practicing, recording, or performing live, Tuner T1 gives you the professional-level tuning accuracy you need.

Download Tuner T1 today and experience the next level of tuning accuracy for all your musical instruments!

The guitar tuner app used by professional guitar makers, guitar repair shops and musicians around the world. 

The app listen and analyze the sound in real time from the built-in mic, headset, guitar clip on or from any other external microphone. It is so accurate that it will be your best friend for guitar intonation!

Because Pro Guitar Tuner is chromatic you can tune most types of stringed instruments. 

High-quality samples of real instruments are also accessible (i.e. tune by ear if preferred!). A massive library of different tunings for guitar, bass, balalaika, violin, ukulele and more makes it easy to find more qualities and characteristics from your instrument. 

The interface:
To make it more intuitive, we give you information about the current pitch in many different ways:

*Cents for the current pitch
*A red/green light indicating the closest pitch
*A note wheel corresponding to the chromatic scale
*A fretboard with the current tuning setting displayed

Standard guitar is set as default but the guitar tuner can be used to tune many different instruments, such as: 
*Guitars - Standard, 4-string, 5-string, 7-string, 8-string
, 9-string, 10-string, 11-string, 12-string, and 13-string guitar
*Bass guitars - Standard, 5-string bass and 6-string bass
*Ukuleles - std (Soprano), Pocket, Concert, Tenor, Baritone, Bass, and Contrabass
*Banjo - 4-string, 5-string, 6-string
*Mandolin family - Mandolin (Soprano), Piccolo, Mandola (alto), Octave Mandolin (tenor), Mandocello (Baritone), Mandobass, Irish Bouzouki, Cittern, and Greek Bouzouki
*Violin family - Violin, Viola, Cello (violoncello), Double bass and 5-string Double bass
*Balalaika family - Prima, Piccolo, Secunda, Alto, Tenor, Bass and Contrabass

After you have selected an instrument you choose a specific tuning. The app provides you with over 200 custom tunings.

The tuning options are divided into groups to make them easier to find. For guitar, the categories are:
*General tunings
*Raised tunings
*Lowered tunings
*Dropped tunings
*Double dropped tunings
*Major open tunings
*Minor open tunings (cross-note)
*Modal tunings
*Miscellaneous tunings

If you have certain tunings that you often use, you can save them as favorites. This gives you easy access to them under favorite tunings.

In the app, you can choose to subscribe to Pro Guitar Tuner Premium. It´s  a monthly subscription that gives you the following features: 

*No Ads
*All Tunings
*All Instruments
*Extra Settings
